## 3. Shared-utilities strategy (module contracts)

**Dependency rule (strict, one-way):** `games → shared`. Shared modules **never** import from a game folder. No cross-game imports. All imports are **relative** (`../shared/core/Engine.js`) — no bare specifiers, no deep path confusion.

| Module | Responsibility | Key API |
|---|---|---|
| `core/Engine.js` | Renderer/scene/camera, fixed-timestep RAF loop w/ timescale hook, resize, **full `dispose()`** (walks scene graph, frees geo/mat/texture) | `createEngine(opts) → { renderer, scene, camera, resize(), dispose() }` |
| `core/Input.js` | Unified dual-input; deadzone + edge detection | `axisX, axisY, fire, jump, pause` (poll each frame) |
| `core/ObjectPool.js` | Pre-allocated, zero-GC pool | `acquire(), release(obj), forEach(fn)` |
| `core/ParticleManager.js` | **Hard cap 500**, `InstancedMesh`-backed, CPU-integrated | `burst({origin,count,vel,spread,color,size,life,gravity})`, `dispose()` |
| `core/CameraShake.js` | Trauma ∈ [0,1], amplitude = trauma², decays | `addTrauma(amount)`, `update(dt)` |
| `core/HitStop.js` | Global timescale dilation | `trigger(duration, timescale)`, `update(dt) → effectiveDt` |
| `core/Shockwave.js` | Pooled emissive rings | `spawn(origin, maxRadius, color)` |
| `core/MotionTrail.js` | Position-ribbon, emissive fade | `attach(obj)`, `update(dt)`, `dispose()` |
| `core/FloatingText.js` | Canvas→texture sprite / projected HTML | `spawn(text, worldPos, color)` |
| `core/AudioEngine.js` | Web Audio synth (osc+gain+filter), no samples | `playSfx(name)`, `startMusic(pattern)`, `setMuted(b)` |
| `fx/PostFX.js` | **Mandatory** EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass | `createPostFX(renderer,scene,camera)`, `resize()`, `dispose()` |
| `math/SimplexNoise.js` | 2D/3D simplex + FBM | `noise2(x,y)`, `noise3(x,y,z)`, `fbm(...)` |
| `math/Curves.js` | Bezier eval + arc-length | `quadBezier(t)`, `cubicBezier(t)`, `arcLength(...)` |
| `materials/NeonMaterials.js` | PBR `MeshStandardMaterial` factory | `makeNeon({color,emissive,emissiveIntensity,metalness,roughness})`, presets |
| `ui/GlassHUD.js` | Glassmorphism DOM overlay | `setScore()`, `setLives()`, `showOverlay()`, `dispose()` |

**Memory policy (enforced in `Engine.dispose()` + every pooled system):** on teardown, traverse the scene graph and call `.dispose()` on every `geometry`, `material` (and each of its `texture` slots), then `renderer.dispose()`. ParticleManager and pools release their `InstancedMesh`/buffers explicitly. No orphaned GPU resources.
